reverse-phase HPLC. MS490.3; no individual yield. Quinoline C3-benzoyl/C8-CF3 and one-methylene O-linker retained.
US7576215B2, Example525/478: bisaryl phenol0.1 g + methyl4-(bromomethyl)benzoate0.057 g; cesium carbonate/DMF,60 C14 h,
